hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, prices the trade using its own AMM curve (not v4 concentrated liquidity), and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault — returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting directly with the PoolManager.
